Hangul only; the two Japanese statutory page titles quoted from the English pages are the only Han/kana runs.
Generated names keep the default order with a space: 천둥 + 봉우리 = 천둥 봉우리, 쌍둥이 + 칼날 = 쌍둥이 칼날.
Japanese names are written by sound in Hangul (Kaito 카이토, Takeda 다케다); Sensei Hoshi is 호시 사범.
Computer players' generated names (Kaito Mori) are stored text and stay in Latin letters, as in every language.
